# Shortcut glyphs

The brand silhouettes in `icons.js` are adapted from [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons) (CC0-1.0, license alongside this file). Source SVG path data: tag `16.0.0`, `icons/{google,youtube,googleclassroom,googledrive,gmail,github,googlegemini,claude,notion,wikipedia,discord,figma}.svg`; OpenAI: tag `14.0.0`, `icons/openai.svg`.

Only the silhouettes are reused. NewTab adds its own SVG layers, gradients, edges, and CSS backdrop effect. The small general-purpose symbols are original. No favicon request or runtime icon CDN is used. Trademarks remain the property of their respective owners.
